name: Performance Home Automation

reviews.name: Gene H.
reviews.text: We have been working with PHA for almost six years on various home electronics projects and couldn't recommend them more.  We have found Chuck and Tommy and the crew to be knowledgeable, responsive and professional in bringing our 20-year-old electronics and security system up-to-date and making it work with our life-style, and once that was done being responsive to the maintenance and repair needs for the system, as well as adding improvements along the line.

reviews.name: Martin G.
reviews.text: PHA is great. They do all my Ledo Pizza restaurants from security, AV systems and cameras. Their service techs are always available to come troubleshoot and fix our issues within 24 hours!

reviews.name: Barbara N.
reviews.text: PHA was fabulous during my home renovation.  We automated Lutron lighting throughout the house, built in sonos speakers and security cameras, all operated from the phone.  They also installed a ring doorbell, where no doorbell existed.  They are reliable, reasonable and professional.  The follow up and customer experience was exceptional.  I highly recommend the PHA team!

reviews.name: Michael M.
reviews.text: Fantastic job getting my home AV set up with all the accoutrements. Very friendly, efficient and priced well. Very pleased.

reviews.name: John M.
reviews.text: We’ve been using PHA for years. They provide great service and support—don’t hesitate to work with them!
